summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery uses single-writer lock and validates LKG, generation identity, hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; older LKG allowed only if ancestor and all inputs byte-match main; restores four formal layers then reruns publication/query/smoke checks; stale LKG rejected; failed validation or activation fully rolls back and verifies prior bytes, with current pointer last; publication scripts must match pinned main; stale lock recovery requires definite death/reuse or malformed lock after 60s, live/indeterminate owner blocks; pruning separate via prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune; protects current, LKG, and five newest-to-main valid successful generations; deletion requires canonical policy, intent, per-target authorization, isolation, and evidence; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized generations retained; failure logs append-only outside pruning; extends ADR-0048, complements and does not supersede ADR-0044; retention policy versioned and ADR-governed
